li.label: natural netrunner
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} took to the net like others take to walking. Cyberspace does not get under {PAWN_possessive} skin as deep: Netsick grows 40% slower, and {PAWN_possessive} hacks in dives land 5% more often.

li.label: net veteran
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has come back clean from the net more times than anyone can count. {PAWN_possessive} hacks in dives land 10% more often, but the net lets go slowly: Netsick fades 20% slower.

li.label: ghost hand
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} once went thirty dives without ICE ever touching {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} moves through nodes like a draft: dive trace is 15% lower.

li.label: burnt
li.description: Black ICE has burned {PAWN_nameDef} so often that the pain no longer reaches {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} never gets cyberspace nausea, but {PAWN_possessive} first move in a dive is slow: one action less in the first turn.

li.label: alien in flesh
li.description: After a hundred and fifty dives {PAWN_nameDef} feels more at home in the net than in {PAWN_possessive} own body. {PAWN_pronoun} is happy in the cyberpod and gloomy when {PAWN_pronoun} has not dived for three days.
